instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Orbit Industries is a specialized general contractor focused on complex multi-family residential projects and light commercial builds across three states. We manage 6-8 active construction sites simultaneously with a network of over 30 vetted subcontractors, operating in an environment characterized by stringent local building codes and evolving sustainability mandates. Current focus includes leveraging Building Information Modeling (BIM) for clash detection and deploying drone technology to automate site progress monitoring.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration within the core planning group. Furthermore, we piloted a mobile application for field crews to streamline submittal tracking and issue logging on site.
answers.strategicGoals: We aim to double revenue within 3 years by entering two new geographic markets and launching a direct-to-consumer channel alongside our existing B2B distribution. Our top priority is identifying scalable customer acquisition channels and building the operational capacity to support rapid volume growth without degrading quality or margins.
answers.additionalContext: Preparing for Series A in the next 9 months. We need to articulate a clear, credible innovation strategy that differentiates us from competitors in the eyes of VCs. The narrative must tie our innovation investments directly to defensible competitive advantages and revenue growth projections.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Advanced BIM-Driven Predictive Cost Modeling
opportunities.rationale: Given our high regulatory environment and conservative risk appetite, incremental improvements to existing workflows are safest. Implementing a low-cost module within our current BIM framework can help project managers predict material waste and schedule overruns more accurately.

first_actions: Identify a low-cost API or plugin compatible with existing BIM software (e.g., Revit/Navisworks).
Run a pilot study on 5 active projects to validate cost prediction accuracy vs. actual spend.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: 10 hours of founder time for initial integration review.
$3,000 for specialized software training and consultant consultation.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce project budget variance by 5% within the pilot phase.
milestones: Month 2: Pilot launch and data collection initiated.

opportunities.title: Standardized Mobile Field Data & Subcontractor Interface (MVP)
opportunities.rationale: To address culture and process barriers, we need a bold shift in how site data is captured to improve subcontractor accountability without requiring massive internal platform builds. A simple web-based MVP for daily reporting can drastically streamline communication.

first_actions: Define the minimum viable feature set (e.g., photo upload, checklist completion).
Select a low-code platform like Glide or AppSheet to rapidly build and deploy.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: 20 hours of outsourced development time for MVP.
$5,000 contingency fund allocated from the innovation budget.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 80% weekly subcontractor reporting compliance using the mobile tool.
milestones: Month 1: Define requirements and select platform.
Month 3: MVP launch on one active project site.

next_steps.action: Formalize a dedicated 'Innovation Sandbox' process to manage low-risk radical ideas.
Conduct stakeholder interviews (subcontractors and project managers) to identify the top three workflow pain points for immediate incremental improvement.

key_weaknesses: Owner-dependency in decision-making limits strategic bandwidth and scaling potential.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) presents significant risk when attempting radical technology adoption.
Fragmented operational process structure hinders the formalization of innovation initiatives into measurable results.
Limited budget allocation (4%) restricts investment size, making large scale R&D impossible.
